project_comments.note: WP-001 and WP-002 can be implemented in parallel as they have no dependencies. Consider combining them into a single implementation session for efficiency.
WP-003 (Jerk fields) requires nested XML element extraction which differs from the existing flat attribute pattern. Developer may need to create a helper function or use direct DOM queries.
Nice-to-have work packages (WP-006, WP-007) are intentionally lower priority. Core physics data (WP-001 through WP-005) should be completed first to unblock the Cargo Sizes Mod GUI.

PHPStan at level 5 shows pre-existing errors with ArrayDataCollection::getInt/getFloat method signatures. These errors existed before this implementation and follow the existing codebase pattern. No new architectural issues introduced.
